reviews.text: This is a great game! Must buy if you like action rpgs and tower defense!

Suprisingly fun. Went into this one with no expectations but it's a decent so far. It takes a while to get into the actual TD areas though and there is A LOT of text, but the game can be played without reading :P
Having an ABSOLUTE BLAST! The game feels so much better than the demo and the boss fights are actually fun! Might 100% this one!

Just put in < 2 hrs of this game, have played the demo too. I checked out SS's last game also, whcih while niche i enjoyed. They've really leveled up here. This is a game of WEIGHT. Each swing is deliberate, positioning important, mistakes punishing. Take it slow, soak in the battles (both combat and the TD portions, which are a bit easy so far but its early days). I like the mix as well of the 2, and i hope it ramps up both elements (and melds em together) to 11 when i get deeper. Some menu jank and a few UI improvements to be made, but the game has some good bones. A bit more polish and we are looking one of 2026's indie gems

I really wanted to like this game. On paper, everything about this game appeals to me, from the core mechanics to the art presented. The glaring negatives: - Twice dodge rolled into a wall and got stuck, forcing myself to reload a save and lose progress. - Computer turned into an oven on just medium settings. - Zones are a mile wide with nothing in them. - Music a complete afterthought. - Next-to-no tactile feedback from hitting enemies. - Map feels impressively unhelpful. I think there is a good game here. Maybe when they add the roguelike gamemode it'll feel more tightened up and straight to the fun bits, but right now I have to give it a hard no.

I usually don't write review for games but i am actually impressed with the game. Didn't expect much but the game delivers everything it claims to be and is very satisfying to play. Looking forward to playing more.

What a smooth gameplay. Combat is really nice. Boss fight was real fun. I thought the dude would almost destroy entire swamp region. Also the game has no bugs, maybe 1 or 2 glitches but can be fixed. when do you see a game without bugs. this one is worth it.

I have been following this game for quite some time now, and I can easily say that it surpassed my expectations. The game certainly felt more tuned it from its demo and the voice acting was surprisingly good. I have not finished it yet, but i certainly look forward to it and I am definitely going to check out what they will be working on next as well!

Unexpected treasure of a game. I am the type to platinum souls-like games and despite this not being of the same genre, I am exploring the possibility given it's addictive combat. The first boss fight was actually fun. Looking forward to more.
Great ideas here and we need more of this innovation in gaming. But it plays like an alpha test with a ton of issues.

Interesting mix of Action RPG with tower defense elements, which was a nice surprise. The visuals are solid and the overall style really stands out. I did run into a few bugs here and there, but nothing game-breaking. Overall, I’m having fun so far and curious to see how it evolves.

Explore, build, defend, and fight, I loved it thoroughly. The tower defense gameplay is great, and I really appreciated how it avoids unnecessary complexity in building or resource collection. The onboarding is simple and smooth. Animations and effects are decent, and the lore adds an interesting layer of depth. There’s still room for improvement in upcoming patches. When the player is on low HP, there’s no music or SFX to reflect the tension, which makes those moments feel less impactful. The save system could be better, being unable to recover until the next save point is frustrating. I also experienced two crashes during heavy combat. The bosses could be a bit more challenging, though the core tower defense mechanics are top-notch. My rating would be 9/10. I also noticed the note on the main menu, an interesting way to share the devs’ perspective. It really shows how much effort they’ve put into the game over time.
fun game but little buggy but its ok. them try patch the game
Fun and interesting mix of combat and tower defense. Combat is slower than some other games but feels heavy. The critical hit timing part is very nicely done .
This game needs to go back in the oven, it's not finished. Glitches range from tons of minor annoyances to barrier breaking.
Fans of Diablo will enjoy this game. Has a creative wave defense mechanic that is fun. Visuals are really nice, audio design good too. Would recommend!
You are an Apprentice Paladin, following your Master on your first quest. Survive by engaging your enemies in deliberate and impactful combat with a variety of play styles.
March 2025
Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves.
Frontier Paladin got that excellent charm of being an adventure with great atmosphere. Another interesting project from a small indie studio.
Good
The mix of deliberate stamina-based combat and defensive preparation works surprisingly well. Every victory feels earned, especially when a carefully planned fortification holds the line.
A casual isometric hack-and-slash that also combines tower defense. Protect the empire as a paladin, defeat demons, and safeguard others with your skills and setting up your defenses.
